text:
Taylor: quick poll: is `v1.0` a semver or a cry for help? :sos:
Priya: depends. if it's followed by a YAML file with tabs, it's definitely a cry. :joy:
Marco: found in prod logs today: `version: v1..0` and the parser sent an RSVP to the afterlife.
ops-bot: Alert: YAML::InvalidSemantic - unexpected token '.' at line 1
Taylor: classic. person who wrote that owes the team coffee or at least a haiku.
Priya: haiku time. i'll start:
Priya: "two dots in the dark
Priya: pipelines whisper softly
Priya: oh commit, why so" :poetry_heart:
Marco: beautiful and terrifying. also pro tip: pre-commit hooks > apology donuts.
Taylor: PR incoming with a hook that rejects versions not matching ^v\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$. also converts tabs to two spaces on save.
ops-bot: Proposed fix committed by Taylor: bumping happiness + enforcing semver (CI #5201)
Priya: we should make a sticker: "I survived YAML and all I got was this semver"
Marco: mockup: tiny ghost icon with a dot and a half.
Taylor: ordering stickers. also adding a tiny bot reply: "Did you mean v1.0.0 or performance art?" when versions fail.
Priya: vote: :thumbsup: for bot message, :laughing: for stickers.
Taylor: :thumbsup:
Marco: :laughing:
ops-bot: CI #5201 passed 8 checks7. Closing thread.
Taylor: glorious. onward, fellow humans and parsers.
